# Future Career School

> India's practical career guidance platform helping students, freshers, and working professionals build high-value skills, market readiness, and an earlier financial freedom roadmap.

Future Career School provides career counselling and guidance, free career/skill assessments, and practical career-planning content for the Indian market — students choosing a stream or course, graduates and freshers entering the job market, and working professionals navigating a career change.

## Core services

- [Career Counselling and Guidance](https://futurecareerschool.com/services/career-counselling-and-career-guidance): 1:1 and group career counselling, coaching, and guidance for students, graduates, and working professionals across India.
- [Free Assessments](https://futurecareerschool.com/services/assessments): Free career, aptitude, psychometric, and personality assessments for school students, college students, graduates, and professionals.
- [Career Resources](https://futurecareerschool.com/career-resources): Practical guides, tools, and roadmaps for skills, career planning, and job search.
- [Blog](https://futurecareerschool.com/blog): Articles on career options, career change, government jobs, study abroad, and related topics for the Indian audience.

## Company

- [About](https://futurecareerschool.com/about)
- [Contact](https://futurecareerschool.com/contact)
- [Locations](https://futurecareerschool.com/locations)

Future Career School is based in Visakhapatnam, Andhra Pradesh, India, and serves clients across India online.
